name: Splithoof Hold
summary: Splithoof Hold is a deep cavern stronghold carved into the stone of Splithoof Crag in Thousand Needles. Held by the Galak centaur tribe, the cavern serves as a fortified den and houses the Ancient Brazier, a site holding an eternally burning sacred flame.

sections.title: A Centaur Bastion
sections.body: Tucked away inside Splithoof Crag, Splithoof Hold serves as a fortified redoubt for the Galak centaur. Unlike the windswept canyon floor, this enclosed cave offers them shelter, defensible chokepoints, and a secure sanctuary from rival tribes and travelers passing through the Needles.

sections.title: The Sacred Flame
sections.body: Deep within the shadowed recesses of the hold lies an ancient brazier cradling the Sacred Flame. This mystic fire burns incessantly, serving as a focal point of power and ritual reverence for the centaur and an object of deep curiosity for spiritual wanderers across the canyon.

faq.answer: Splithoof Hold is situated within the crags and ramparts of Splithoof Crag, along the northern cliffs of Thousand Needles. It is entered through a cave opening nestled inside the main centaur settlement.
The cavern is held by the Galak centaur tribe, who aggressively defend the cave against outsiders, beast incursions, and the nearby tauren of Freewind Post.
Beyond hostile Galak centaur defenders, the cave houses the Ancient Brazier, an artifact that keeps the mystical Sacred Flame burning eternally within the depths of the rock.

angles.text: The Galak centaur remain sworn blood enemies of the tauren, making any stronghold they maintain in Thousand Needles an immediate threat to the peace of Freewind Post.
The existence of an eternal flame burning deep within a dark stone cavern draws the attention of any spiritualist attuned to the primal mysteries of elemental fire.
